description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LocalizationService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing localization functionalities such as language formats, error handling, and processing XLIFF files.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test suite for testing the LocalizationService functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, sets up the LocalizationService instance, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Tests retrieval of localized date format options, asserting the count and specific format labels.

methods.name: testGetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Verifies that getSupportedLanguages returns the expected list.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Checks that searchLanguages interacts correctly with the DAO and returns expected results.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests retrieval of language array with label and code.

methods.name: testGenerateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Verifies the generation of language key string based on language and unit IDs.

methods.name: testExportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of localization groups for export.

methods.name: testGetXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Tests the generation of XLIFF XML sources for different language IDs, parsing the content, and validating structure and content.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForInvalidSyntaxTest
methods.description: Creates a mock LocalizationService configured to simulate an invalid syntax error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithInvalidSyntaxString
methods.description: Tests validation of a target string with invalid syntax, expecting an I18NError with INVALID_SYNTAX.

methods.name: getMockLocalizationServiceForValidateLangStringTesting
methods.description: Creates a mock LocalizationService configured to test validation of language strings and error conditions based on given string value and error name.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholders
methods.description: Ensures no error for valid target string without placeholders.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutPlaceholdersError
methods.description: Tests for mismatch error when placeholders don't align.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholders
methods.description: Validates string with correct placeholders passes without error.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPlaceholdersInDifferentOrder
methods.description: Checks correct placeholder order acceptance.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPlaceholders
methods.description: Detects mismatch when placeholders differ.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithPluralString
methods.description: Validates correct syntax for plural forms.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralCategories
methods.description: Validates matching of plural categories in strings.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithoutOtherPluralCategory
methods.description: Detects syntax errors for missing 'other' category.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects errors when plural variable is missing.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentPluralVariable
methods.description: Detects errors when plural variable names are inconsistent.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithSelectVariable
methods.description: Validates correct select variable syntax.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectOtherCategory
methods.description: Detects missing 'other' category in select syntax.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithMissingSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects missing select variable.

methods.name: testValidateTargetStringWithDifferentSelectVariable
methods.description: Detects mismatch in select variable name.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Tests fetching an I18NError object by its name.

methods.name: testGetI18NErrorWithInvalidErrorName
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when an invalid error name is requested.

methods.name: testLanguageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks whether the system correctly detects import errors for a given language.

methods.name: testClearImportErrorsForLangString
methods.description: Verifies that import errors are cleared correctly for specified language string IDs.

methods.name: getBase64AttachmentForTestingProcessXliff
methods.description: Prepares a mock Base64Attachment for testing XLIFF processing with given content.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyContent
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when processing an empty XLIFF file.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidContent
methods.description: Validates handling of malformed XLIFF content.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidVersion
methods.description: Checks invalid XLIFF version handling.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Checks missing version attribute in XLIFF.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingSourceLanguage
methods.description: Tests handling missing source language in XLIFF.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithMissingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Tests handling missing target language in XLIFF.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidTargetLanguageForLanguageId
methods.description: Detects invalid target language code for given language ID.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithEmptyTargetString
methods.description: Tests processing of XLIFF with empty target strings; expects skipped entries.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithValidAndInvalidTargetStrings
methods.description: Validates correct and incorrect target string processing.

methods.name: testProcessXliffFileWithInvalidLangStrings
methods.description: Checks invalid language string syntax detection.
